verdict.rationale: React's official docs explicitly recommend full-stack frameworks such as Next.js (App Router) or React Router for building whole apps. React also documents framework-facing features like server-side async data fetching and 'use client' that these frameworks implement. However, the recommended frameworks are not first-party React projects, so the 'official meta-framework' element is met only by endorsement rather than ownership. Missing for 10: a first-party React-owned meta-framework, first-party documentation of routing and data-fetching APIs in such a framework, and independent corroboration.
